ghost.premise: Why this scene opens appears here once it's read.
ghost.summary: A one-line summary appears once this scene is read.
ghost.conclusion: How this scene ends (its outcome or cliffhanger) appears here once it's read.
ghost.purpose: The goals and conflicts driving this scene appear here once it's read.
ghost.cast: Characters present in this scene are listed here.
ghost.threads: Threads opened, advanced, or resolved in this scene appear here.
ghost.arc: Character state changes (alignment, knowledge, power…) in this scene appear here once it's read.
ghost.entities: Items, factions, and other tracked entities present in this scene appear here.
ghost.lore: World-facts revealed in this scene appear here once it's read.

ghost.secrets: Secrets learned or exposed in this scene appear here.
